name: Ryan Ottley
description: Ryan Ottley is an American comic book artist and writer, best known for his dynamic work on Invincible (Image Comics) and The Amazing Spider-Man (Marvel). He illustrated 127 of the 144 issues of Invincible , co-creating iconic characters like Battle Beast and Conquest. After Invincible , he joined Marvel to draw 20 issues of Spider-Man , where he helped introduce the villain Kindred. Ottley later worked on Hulk , eventually taking over as both artist and writer. In 2025, he reunited with Robert Kirkman to launch Invincible Universe: Battle Beast , expanding the franchise he helped define.
